authority: Ho Chi Minh City — Saigon Waterbus (Thuong Nhat Group, under HCMC Department of Transport)
decarbonization_anchor: HCMC is expanding a green public-transport network (25 new electric bus routes from 2025; city commitment to convert public transport to green energy). Saigon Waterbus Line 1 (opened 2017, ~10.8 km along the Saigon River and Thanh Da Canal) is the river spine the city already runs; further water-bus lines are planned as part of Water Transit-Oriented Development for HCMC. Vietnam net-zero-by-2050 (COP26).
operator_facts: Saigon Waterbus operated by Thuong Nhat Group for the HCMC Department of Transport. Line 1: Bach Dang (District 1) – Binh An – Thanh Da – Linh Dong (Thu Duc); ~10.8 km; catamaran river-bus vessels ~66 pax.
